correctness.rationale: The source's equivalence between the branch condition and A_n>B_n is used exactly as stated. Strict gamma log-convexity gives an explicit upper bound for B_n. A parity-wise elementary bound on Gamma(n/2+1) gives A_n>1/(2 sqrt(n)) in every dimension. The B_n bound strengthens to B_n<1/(2 sqrt(n)) for n>=14, giving an analytic infinite tail. For 3<=n<=13, B_n<1/sqrt(n) analytically and an exact rational certificate proves A_n>1/sqrt(n); n=2 is checked symbolically. Thus no finite computation is extrapolated to infinitely many dimensions.
